description.en: Display-layer translation for the DSH Web UI: renders thinking chains (chain-of-thought), task cards and answers in one of 8 target languages, with local Ollama or Google/Bing providers and originals preserved.
description.zh: DSH Web 显示层翻译：将思考链、任务卡片与回答以 8 种目标语言之一显示，支持本地 Ollama 或 Google/Bing，原文完整保留。
